svg.title: WARHEATMAP - WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON THE MAP
svg.desc: Measured from the live warheatmap.app public event feed on 2026-10-04: every one of the 6,103 verified, live events was read, not a sample. 18 event types, 192 named conflicts, 169 countries, 1,677 source names as recorded. By severity: critical 865 (14.2%); high 3,037 (49.8%); medium 1,983 (32.5%); low 218 (3.6%). By type: airstrike 1,115 (18.3%); ground battle 931 (15.3%); diplomacy 849 (13.9%); protest 484 (7.9%); other 455 (7.5%); missile 452 (7.4%); naval 437 (7.2%); infrastructure 318 (5.2%); humanitarian 318 (5.2%); terrorism 170 (2.8%); sanctions 133 (2.2%); explosion 130 (2.1%); border crossing 94 (1.5%); assassination 81 (1.3%); migration 68 (1.1%); cyber 35 (0.6%); nuclear 26 (0.4%); coup 7 (0.1%).
